_note: Templates. {UPPERCASE} slots draw a fresh atom each time; {lowercase} slots are the story's own fields ({first}, {place}, {want}...). {the_thing}, {the_someone}, {the_message}, {the_disaster} reuse something an earlier beat introduced: favored when it exists, never used when it doesn't. Tagged entries are favored in those genres.
entries: Then {THING} turned up {HIDING}, and nothing about {TOPIC} made sense any more.
Then {SOMEONE} turned out to be {BETRAYAL}, and {first} had to see {CLOSE} differently.
Then {first} saw {landmark} anew: it was built over {THING}.
Then {DISASTER} ended suddenly, and {SOMEONE} was gone.
Then {MESSAGE} arrived {MANNER}, written to {first} years before.

entries.text: Then, at high noon, {SOMEONE} rode in and handed {first} {THING}.
Then, at midnight, {SOMEONE} knocked and asked for {THING} back.
